Definition: to sling; also to carve (as if a circular motion, or into light forms)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to sling, hurl forth; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to sling; 1a2) slinger (participle); 1b) (Piel) to sling; 2) (Qal) to carve
